title: St Martin's School Kibarage polling station 1 of 7 (Kitisuru Ward, Westlands, Nairobi)

claim.sentence: the affidavit of Arnold Ochieng Oginga deals with this polling station at paragraph 17 and in the table at pages 8 to 13. According to the table, the agent's Form 34A shows Raila Odinga 233 and William Ruto 51, and the portal form shows Raila Odinga 233 and William Ruto 121. The affidavit gives the increase for William Ruto as 70 votes.
